content: When Magic: The Gathering ‘s Marvel’s Spider-Man set launched in 2025, the inclusion of The Soul Stone hinted at the scope of Wizards of the Coast’s partnership with Marvel. Including one of the six cosmically powerful gems as the set’s headliner card practically guaranteed the rest would eventually be released, a plan that was confirmed with the printing of The Mind Stone in the 2026 Marvel Super Heroes set. It’s a clever strategy, but one that Magic head game designer Mark Rosewater told Polygon demonstrates a problem with Universes Beyond design.
